title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Because my editor is making me ask: Are you guys a finalist for Ohtani?
Your editor is an idiot. We have no international money and we are not on Ohtani’s radar. I spoke to the agent whom I know well.
I know, I tried telling him this
I am not playing make believe or a fake news story I have always been up front and straight forward with what we do
I know. Glad to hear you’re feeling better.
Yes. Getting there. Flu kicked my ass. But I did not miss a day
Good report. Sorry to bug you about this. I will give you a call tomorrow afternoon
